description: Licensing constants stated as exact values in platform/understand/licensing.mdx. Each entry pins the Go declaration that is the source of truth. Run check.sh against local clones of loft-sh/loft-enterprise and loft-sh/vcluster-pro to detect drift.

constants.name: refreshLicenseInterval
constants.documented_as: Platform refreshes its license every 6 hours

constants.name: gracePeriodOnLicenseError
constants.documented_as: 7-day grace period before the platform exits when retrieval keeps failing

constants.name: licenseCacheSecretName
constants.documented_as: Name of the platform's cached license Secret

constants.name: refreshLicenseInterval
constants.documented_as: Offline license key mode re-evaluates usage every minute

constants.name: keyExpiryWarningDays
constants.documented_as: Expiration warning starts 90 days before key expiry

constants.name: keyExpiryGraceDays
constants.documented_as: 30-day grace period after an offline key expires

constants.name: warnLimitThreshold
constants.documented_as: Limit warning announcement fires at 90% of a resource limit

constants.name: sendUsageSnapshotInterval
constants.documented_as: Usage snapshots are sent every 15 minutes

constants.name: LicenseCertSecretName
constants.documented_as: Secret holding the platform's instance identity

constants.name: EnvOfflineLicenseKey
constants.documented_as: Environment variable that selects offline license key mode

constants.name: EnvOfflineLicenseServer
constants.documented_as: Environment variable that selects offline license server mode

constants.name: EnvStaticLicenseToken
constants.documented_as: Environment variable supplying a static activation token

constants.name: featureCacheTTL
constants.documented_as: Tenant cluster feature cache expires after 7 days

constants.name: refreshLicenseInterval
constants.documented_as: A tenant cluster's own offline license key is re-checked every hour

constants.name: PlatformAccessKeyEnv
constants.documented_as: Second entry in the tenant cluster access key precedence chain

constants.name: PlatformHostEnv
constants.documented_as: Environment variable overriding the platform host
